description: Remarkable architectural design, generous proportions and exquisite finishes define this exceptional residence, tailored to contemporary family living. Enjoy seamless access to Marrickville's amenities including vibrant shops, schools, parks and transport.

Perched on level seven, this stylish one-bedroom apartment combines contemporary comfort with impressive leafy and district outlooks. Light-filled interiors extend to a sheltered balcony, while secure parking, storage and a study nook enhance everyday convenience.

Placed along a row of character homes in a tree-line street, this upgraded family residence radiates excellence with acute attention to detail. It possesses numerous original features, including coloured glazing, multiple fireplaces, high ornate ceilings and pristine timber floorboards. Every room is generously proportioned for comfort, across a classic three-bed floorplan that culminates in a sensational entertaining area with a stainless-steel kitchen, a dining setting with a fireplace, plus a full-width verandah that overlooks the northerly garden. There is plenty of space on this block to further extend the home subject to council approval (STCA), while its perfect presentation will warrant leaving it as it is and reaping all the rewards of the Marrickville postcode without haste. This address is placed between two train stations and there is a café on the corner of the street, while shops, parks, schools and light rail services are all within close proximity.

Set within a quiet, tree-lined street, this freestanding late 1800s Victorian terrace presents an exciting opportunity on an impressive 524.9sqm (approx.) parcel of land. Featuring four bedrooms, two bathrooms and off-street parking, the property provides plenty of scope to renovate and restore the existing terrace or explore the potential to create a brand-new home (S.T.C.A.). With Marrickville Station, multiple other transport options, Marrickville Road's vibrant shops, cafes and bars, schools and parks all within easy walking distance, this is a rare opportunity to secure a substantial parcel of land in a highly sought-after location.

Housed within the acclaimed 'Globe Mills' complex, this rare find is the only apartment to feature an outdoor terrace in the coveted warehouse conversion. With resort-worthy facilities on site and only one block back from Enmore Park, it's the epitome of urban living.

With fresh interiors and a backdrop of leafy greenery, this smartly revamped apartment delivers an easy-living retreat matched by a quiet location of easy convenience. It makes a great low-maintenance home that's well presented throughout with refreshed interiors and a highly private position close to the heart of Dulwich Hill. This peaceful lifestyle setting is also within a 300m stroll to the Metro station, light rail and village cafes, and only a couple of blocks from the Cooks River parklands and the new Greenway.

There's something truly special about stepping into a home where every detail has been perfectly considered, with flawless interiors flowing seamlessly to an exceptional outdoor entertainer's paradise. Welcome to the future of luxurious modern living in this brand-new residence, where sensational style, high-end finishes and meticulous craftsmanship come together in spectacular fashion. Exclusively positioned within Marrickville's sought-after Warren Estate precinct, it offers a thoughtfully designed layout that makes everyday living and entertaining easy.

Positioned in a highly convenient lifestyle location, this freestanding home presents a rare opportunity for buyers looking to undertake a renovation project and create a home tailored to their own style and vision. Retaining much of its original character, the property offers separate lounge and dining areas, two bedrooms, an additional room ideal for a study or storage, and original kitchen and bathroom spaces. Offering outstanding potential to transform and add value, this is the perfect opportunity for renovators, builders or creative buyers looking to reimagine a freestanding home and capitalise on its sought-after location. Enjoying a vibrant setting within walking distance to Marrickville Road's shops, cafes, bars and restaurants, as well as parks, schools and public transport, this is an exciting chance to secure a home with enormous future potential in the heart of the inner west.

For nearly one hundred years, this semi-detached home has known only one family, welcomed as tenants in c1928 and embraced as owners not long after. Cherished across four generations, its rich period character has been lovingly preserved, ready now to begin a new story.

A street behind the lively Illawarra Road, this top-floor apartment catches the city skyline from its entertainer's balcony, with new engineered oak floorboards running through an open living domain. Marrickville Station, cafes and supermarkets sit within this enviably walkable pocket.

In the premier north-facing position, this 65sqm home (plus 13sqm parking) is one of the biggest 1-bedroom designs in the 'Globe Mills' conversion. With warehouse bones and incredible sense of space throughout, the oversized windows and high ceilings ensure plenty of light and wow factor, while the setting puts you in one of the area's best-regarded buildings.
Located in the heart of Dulwich Hill, this modern apartment offers unbeatable convenience just 96m to train and light rail, with easy access to the CBD and Marrickville lifestyle precinct.

Presenting an exceptional opportunity, this beautifully appointed two-bedroom home combines a unique dual-level layout with contemporary interiors, generous proportions and an abundance of natural light. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, the home features a spacious open-plan living and dining area with floor to ceiling windows that creates a welcoming sense of space and seamless flow throughout. Being conveniently located only steps to public transport including the light rail, soon to be Metro, local shops, eateries & parklands, this home is perfect for all.

Bathed in northerly sunlight from its generous entertainers' terrace, this immaculate apartment is oversized, modern and sensationally positioned in a vibrant, coveted pocket of Marrickville. House-like proportions host a beautifully curated design, made for easy, private and stylish living.

Designed with a practical and user-friendly layout for modern living, this quality one-bedroom plus study courtyard apartment delivers the ideal home for today's demands. With private alfresco areas to entertain, you can extend your lifestyle outdoors and appreciate the sunlit spaces that make it an easy low-maintenance place to live. This is the perfect package for owner occupiers, a low-care investment or a scale down opportunity as it's stylishly appointed, very secure and positioned just 200m to Marrickville Road, with shopping, café and dining options strolling distance from the front door.

Experience the ultimate modern lifestyle in this stunning top-floor residence, offering panoramic city views from its enviable north east facing position. Designed for effortless living and entertaining, the open-plan lounge, dining and kitchen area flows seamlessly to the outdoors, with sleek herringbone-style floors on display throughout. The gourmet kitchen sets the tone for the home's luxurious ambiance featuring marble benchtops and premium Smeg appliances, while the generous accommodation and stylish bathrooms complete this quality city-fringe retreat. Positioned in a prime location, it's just a short stroll to Marrickville Station, parks and a vibrant array of shopping and dining options, while also being very convenient for the CBD.

Enjoy easy ground floor living in this well-presented two-bedroom apartment, quietly positioned within a boutique security building of just eight apartments. Offering a leafy outlook and a practical layout, the apartment features polished timber floors throughout, split system air conditioning, a renovated bathroom and a neat and tidy kitchen complete with a convenient servery. The main bedroom opens onto a private balcony and includes a built-in wardrobe. Complete with a car space and ideally positioned close to transport, schools, parks and local shops, this is a comfortable home in a convenient location.

Beautifully refreshed while retaining its timeless period charm, this character home showcases soaring ornate ceilings, generous proportions and an abundance of natural light. Blending classic elegance with modern comfort, it presents an exceptional opportunity for families, professionals and investors seeking space, flexibility and everyday convenience in one of Marrickville's most sought-after lifestyle pockets.

Quietly tucked away in one of Marrickville's most desirable pockets, this beautifully presented dual-level semi offers a superb blend of character, flexibility and Inner West convenience. Bathed in sunlight, the oversized two-bedroom layout combines inviting indoor and outdoor living with a versatile upper level and private entertaining spaces. Just metres from the vibrant cafés, restaurants and boutiques of Illawarra and Marrickville Roads, it's also a short stroll to the revitalised Marrickville Library precinct, city transport and the soon-to-open Marrickville Metro station.

Idyllically positioned in one of the suburb's finest locales, this generous double-fronted home with elaborate period features and exceptionally spacious dimensions, provides immediate family comfort and is within easy walking distance to Marrickville and Tempe train stations, vibrant cafes and a plethora of eclectic eateries. Set within lovely, established garden surrounds, this fine home retains its charming traditional attributes, which includes its gracious tesselated tiled return verandah, elaborate plaster ceilings and original timber fireplaces.
Perfectly positioned in a quiet, tree lined street just moments from Henson Park, this solid brick semi offers space, flexibility and lifestyle in one of Marrickville's most sought after pockets.

This spacious and bright double-fronted residence offers a rare size, charm and location, perfect for any family looking to upsize to a solid full brick home and renovate to suit requirements. Quietly positioned just a couple of blocks to Marrickville Road amenities, it makes a standout property and a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for those wanting to acquire a large freestanding character home with so much future potential. It's now on the market for the first time in about 70 years, and although presented in immaculate order, there is exciting scope for an update, redesign or complete transformation (STCA) to capitalise on its premium address.

Behind an exquisite façade in a park-side precinct, beautifully elegant and brilliantly conceived renovations have harnessed the grace of this traditional home and given it a modern twist. Equal parts style and whimsical appeal, the sleek stone crafted kitchen and dining flow out to a delightful private alfresco space, magical garden and the rear lane access to its oversized garage. Marble fireplaces retain the warmth found in the lounge and two of the three bedrooms. Every element has been updated with care and precision to craft a superb retreat, metres to Enmore Park, Marrickville Metro and the bus.

Tucked away in a quiet pocket of Marrickville on the edge of the Cooks River Parklands, this newly built residence delivers a bold architectural presence with a design that feels both robust and refined. Freestanding to the north, the two-storey home has been conceived with longevity and scale in mind, its artisan brickwork and carefully curated materials creating a distinctive identity. Inside, a striking interplay of polished and off-form concrete, travertine, timber and glass creates a sophisticated industrial aesthetic with a subtle warehouse inspired feel. Luxurious yet restrained, the minimalist interiors draw on the philosophy of wabi-sabi, celebrating natural textures and quiet imperfection to create a sanctuary of calm. Layered in warm tones and tactile finishes, the result is a beautifully crafted, low maintenance turnkey haven designed for effortless contemporary living just 600m to Dulwich Hill village and station.

Within the coveted 'Warren Estate,' this skylit Federation semi has been beautifully reimagined for the modern family, its entire top floor devoted to a private parents' sanctuary with a balcony, ensuite and home office. Steel Park and the new Metro shape the neighbourhood just beyond.

Set on one of Warren Estate's finest tree-lined streets, this renovated freestanding family home bookends its floor plan with outdoor space, a remarkable oversized terrace soaking up the street's leafy aspect at the front, and a lush elevated garden oasis at the rear. Proximity to Mackey Park, Tempe Station, and Illawarra Road dining all round out this exceptional offering.

Positioned in a highly convenient Marrickville pocket just moments from the suburb's vibrant village hub, this character-filled bungalow presents an outstanding opportunity to move straight in, renovate or explore future redevelopment potential (STCA). Set on approximately 297sqm, the home offers four generous bedrooms, three with built-in wardrobes, along with a functional layout and off-street parking suited to a motorbike or small personal transport. With strong fundamentals and a location that continues to evolve, it delivers immediate liveability with exciting scope to enhance or completely reimagine in one of the Inner West's most connected lifestyle precincts.

Four bedrooms, soaring ceilings, a generous, sunlit yard with rear lane access, all awaiting a cosmetic refresh. The bones are all here: double brick throughout, open brick features, separate living and dining rooms with strong proportions. The yard with grand space, light and potential.

From the moment you walk in the door, this tastefully renovated period semi makes you feel good with its sense of easy urban style. The gorgeous character home has been cleverly upgraded to provide a fresh and bright living space with a low-maintenance layout and private garden sanctuary that go together to provide a fantastic in/outdoor environment. It's also perfectly positioned with Marrickville's vibrant dining scene, wine bars, cafés and the Sydenham Metro all within strolling distance.

Privately enveloped in beautiful leafy surrounds and graced with natural light, this stylish home presents a slice of contemporary comfort with a charming period flavour. Thoughtfully renovated, the home assures a modern functionality and an intelligent use of space without sacrificing the sophistication of its past, featuring a generously proportioned living and dining space with an ornate fireplace. The rear of the home extends out to a remarkable entertainers' deck and courtyard, defined by a lush serenity and the ability to host memorable dinner parties and special family occasions, while the lifestyle versatility of the home is further elevated by a flexible top-floor retreat. Conveniently positioned on the cusp of Marrickville and Newtown, this is an exceptional walk-everywhere location surrounded by adored cafes and diverse restaurants, while moments from Marrickville Metro.

Beautifully restored and thoughtfully renovated, this impressive period home delivers refined family living on a generous scale. Set in a tightly held, tree lined street surrounded by quality residences, the home enjoys a highly sought-after Marrickville address with easy access to both Dulwich Hill and Marrickville village amenities.

Nestled in a tranquil pocket of Marrickville, just moments to local attractions, this classic Federation residence presents an exceptional opportunity. Whether you're looking to renovate, extend, or start fresh with a designer home or duplex (STCA), this property provides the perfect foundation to create your dream home in one of Sydney's most sought-after Inner West locations.

Rich in timber detail and richer still in character, this soulful four-bedroom family home is ready for its next chapter. Beautifully landscaped gardens and the irresistible energy of Marrickville right at the door complete a home that has been deeply loved and is ready to be loved again.

Traditional charm, smart modern updates and a private entertainers' garden create a great formula for lifestyle enjoyment in this gorgeous brick semi. It displays a flowing interior layout with good natural light throughout and a design that's ideal for low-care living. This superb property package is located in a premium Marrickville neighbourhood on the Stanmore/Petersham border, and you can easily walk to village amenities and transport at both, as well as Newington College and Addison Road's eateries.

Showcasing impressive proportions with an emphasis on space and quality, this expansive Victorian-era residence is an exceptional indoor/outdoor entertainer that will delight the whole family. It has been cleverly designed and laid out to provide light-filled living and low-maintenance alfresco style, plus it enjoys a premium Marrickville setting just a few footsteps to Enmore Park. There's so much on offer here, and the home is superbly appointed, freshly presented throughout and packed with features, including a bonus guest studio with tremendous versatility for multigenerational families or a dual-living arrangement.

One of only ten in a red brick block, this ground-floor apartment offers the kind of renovation potential that first-home buyers and seasoned improvers recognise immediately (STCA). The location needs little introduction, with Marrickville and Dulwich Hill both claiming it as their own.
Step into a rare opportunity to secure a timeless period-style residence, proudly held within the same family for over 55 years.

Set within a tightly held South Cronulla enclave, this beautifully appointed residence delivers an exceptional combination of contemporary design, generous proportions and effortless coastal living. Spanning two impressive levels, the home has been thoughtfully designed around family life, with a selection of light-filled living zones, quality finishes and a seamless connection between the interiors and outdoor entertaining areas.

Enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle from this well-presented two-bedroom apartment, ideally positioned in a convenient and central Cronulla location. Offering a generous floorplan with comfortable living spaces, a modern kitchen and private balcony, the property provides an inviting home with everything you need for easy everyday living.

Offering light filled interiors and positioned on the top floor of a boutique complex, this well presented apartment presents an excellent opportunity for first home buyers, investors or those looking to add value through renovation. Comfortable as is, with exciting scope to modernise and make it your own, this home offers effortless living in a highly convenient location

Quietly positioned on Bay Lane, between Nicholson Parade and Darook Park Road, this home offers an elevated position on the idyllic South Cronulla peninsula just steps from Gunnamatta Bay with commanding water views from most parts of the home. Built in 2000 with grand proportions in mind there is 342sqm (approx.) of home, with a wide frontage towards the water ensuring almost all rooms have views of the Port Hacking.

Nestled in a boutique complex just moments from Cronulla's iconic beaches, vibrant cafés, and easy transport, this home offers the perfect blend of relaxed coastal living and family-friendly design. Bathed in natural light, the layout is thoughtful and versatile, creating a welcoming environment where kids can play, parents can entertain, and everyone can enjoy the best of beachside life.

Designed for comfort and convenience, this spacious three-bedroom residence is ideal for over-55s seeking low-maintenance living. Enjoy seamless lift access from the garage directly to your front door, eliminating stairs and enhancing everyday ease. Well-proportioned interiors, practical layout and a peaceful community setting make this an outstanding lifestyle opportunity.

A new, architect designed coastal home, quietly tucked away just moments to Cronulla's award-winning beaches. Alive with natural light that enhances the breathtaking cathedral ceilings & elegant interiors, this meticulously appointed home is truly stunning

Blending classic symmetry with a fresh Hamptons aesthetic, the interiors are airy and refined, perfectly complementing Australia's love of seamless indoor–outdoor living. Generous proportions, quality finishes and thoughtful design create a home that feels both sophisticated and wonderfully liveable.

Positioned in a boutique block of 6, this spacious apartment delivers an exceptional lifestyle opportunity combining generous interiors, multiple balconies and everyday convenience. Offering a functional layout with light-filled living areas and seamless indoor-outdoor flow, this residence is ideal for first home buyers, investors or those seeking relaxed beachside living.

Rarely in today's real estate market is such a special residence offered for sale on the exclusive South Cronulla peninsula. This superbly maintained family home has truly stood the test of time and is presented in indisputably impeccable condition. A seamless blend of charming detail and graceful interiors creates a choice of formal and informal living areas, with effortless flow to outdoor entertaining and a garden-lovers' rear yard.

Bathed in natural light with a northern aspect, this freshly presented freestanding townhouse offers exceptional space and privacy in a boutique block of seven. High ceilings, entertainer's courtyard and generous 186sqm on title, close to transport, restaurants and cafes with a leafy outlook throughout.

Positioned in a highly desirable location, this spacious, light-filled ground floor apartment offers an exceptional lifestyle opportunity. Featuring a sun-drenched open living and dining area with a prized north aspect, modern kitchen, and three generous bedrooms with oversized windows, it perfectly blends comfort, style, and convenience.

A hard to resist 3-bedroom villa, beautifully updated in warm, coastal tones. Granite kitchen, ducted air-conditioning, built-in robes, 2-car garage, courtyard, sunroom & open-plan lounge/dining. Only minutes to the beach, trains, doctor, post office, cafes & schools.

Nestled on a generous 581.7sqm block set in R3 zoning with a commanding 21.34m frontage, this well-loved, full brick family home presents an exceptional opportunity for families and developers in a sought-after coastal setting. Move in and enjoy as is, personalise to your taste, or take advantage of the potential to renovate, rebuild, or create a cutting-edge architecturally designed dream home or duplex (STCA).

Light-filled and thoughtfully updated, this two bedroom home offers an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle with a calm, coastal feel throughout. The main living area flows to a charming front porch, perfect for slow mornings or relaxed afternoons. Both bedrooms are well-sized, with the main featuring a built-in robe, and the bathroom has been beautifully modernised with a freestanding bath and matte black finishes, adding a touch of everyday luxury.
Situated in one of Cronulla's most desirable beachside pockets, this low maintenance home would suit young families or downsizers which blends easy-care comfort with an enviable location.

Oozing timeless Hamptons charm enhanced by sleek modern finishes, this beautifully renovated home delivers effortless family living across a functional single-level floorplan. Featuring bright and airy interiors that connect seamlessly to a covered alfresco overlooking a sparkling in-ground pool and level yard, offering an inviting space for children to play, making it a true family haven.

Step into a world of unparalleled beachside opulence with this architectural masterpiece that redefines coastal sophistication. Seamlessly blending contemporary elegance with timeless design, every element has been thoughtfully crafted to elevate everyday living. At the heart of the home, expansive open plan living and dining areas flow effortlessly to a private, covered alfresco space and a sun-drenched, sparkling in-ground swimming pool, perfect for year-round entertaining. Positioned just moments from pristine beaches, renowned schools, scenic golf courses, and vibrant local amenities, this exceptional residence offers the ultimate balance of tranquillity and convenience in one of Cronulla's most coveted locations.

Step into a world of timeless style and effortless beachside living with this beautifully maintained Californian Bungalow. Built in 1923 and located in South Cronulla, very sought after & tightly held peninsular.

A distinguished celebration of heritage design, this exceptional residence within the award-winning development 'The Abbey' showcases masterful craftsmanship and timeless appeal. Blending traditional grandeur with modern luxury, every detail has been thoughtfully curated to create a home of lasting beauty, comfort, and refinement. Offering an effortless connection between indoor and outdoor living, it enjoys a prized position between the beach and bay.

Tucked peacefully at the rear of a boutique complex of just five, this contemporary two-bedroom townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, space and coastal convenience. Spread over two generous levels with high ceilings and refreshed interiors, it features a practical free-flowing layout designed for relaxed everyday living.

Azurea sets a new benchmark in luxury beachside living. This architectural masterpiece spans over 256sqm of internal space, offering elegance and comfort with a striking façade, bespoke interiors, seamless indoor-outdoor flow, golf course views, and a private pool-all just 400m from Cronulla's beaches.

Positioned in one of Cronulla's most tightly held waterfront settings, this exceptional residence delivers a rare opportunity in a blue-ribbon location. Originally built in 1953 and completely reimagined in 2006, the home blends timeless solidity with contemporary elegance. An easy floorplan creates seamless flow between the garage entry, kitchen, dining and living areas, while a serene master on the same level offers the ease of near single-level living. Additional accommodation downstairs includes two further bedrooms and a full bathroom, perfect for family or guests.

Set on a prized corner block approx. 580sqm directly opposite Cronulla Golf Club, this is a rare opportunity to acquire an entire block of 8 comprising of 4 x 1br & 4 x 2br apartments. All apartments have been updated throughout with internal laundries and 4 car spaces. With LMR development uplift and just 490m to Elouera beach, shops, cafés and Woolooware train station. Currently returning $208,520pa with scope to increase.

Nestled in one of Cronulla's most exclusive cul-de-sacs, this luxurious coastal residence offers refined living just moments from the beach and town centre. The home features multiple living areas, a gourmet marble kitchen with high-end appliances, and a seamless flow to an alfresco entertaining space and private in-ground pool. Upstairs, the master retreat boasts a media lounge, home office, walk-in robe, and balcony with water views. With four bedrooms, heated-floor bathrooms, secure gated entry, and a double garage, this turnkey home is perfect for modern family living.

Positioned in one of Cronulla's most convenient and sought-after pockets, this sun-drenched home presents a rare opportunity to secure a prime piece of real estate in a tightly held location. Set on a generous block and flooded with natural light, the property offers exciting potential to renovate or knock down and rebuild your dream home (STCA), making it ideal for families, builders, or savvy investors looking to capitalise on this premium coastal setting.

Strategically positioned in peaceful South Cronulla within the luxury Nun's Pool building, this ground floor villa offers unique house-sized living directly opposite Shelly Park, perfect for downsizers and families seeking space.

This stylish and modern three-bedroom townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, with only one common wall to maximise privacy and natural sunlight. Thoughtfully designed, the spacious floorplan flows seamlessly into a sun-drenched entertainer's backyard - ideal for relaxed living and alfresco dining. Perfectly positioned just moments from Cronulla's iconic surf beaches, vibrant cafes, and the local golf course, this is an exceptional opportunity to secure a low-maintenance lifestyle in a sought-after coastal setting.

Nestled in one of North Cronulla's most sought-after cul-de-sac streets, this freestanding three-bedroom home delivers the perfect fusion of timeless design and relaxed coastal living. With light-filled interiors that flow effortlessly to a northeast-facing entertainer's courtyard, the home invites indoor-outdoor living at its best. Surrounded by lush established gardens and thoughtfully crafted for modern lifestyles, it offers generous living spaces that balance comfort and functionality in an idyllic beachside setting.

Set in a peaceful, sought-after street, this charming home presents original character and exciting potential. With a flexible layout, huge outdoor swimming pool, and separate accommodation, this property is the perfect canvas for family living or future renovation in a desired lifestyle location.

Discover the exceptional potential of this cherished family home, proudly offered for the first time since it was built in 1948. Positioned on a prized, level 556.4sqm (approx.) block with a wide 15.24m frontage, the property sits among quality residences in a highly sought-after Cronulla property pocket. Whether you're planning a thoughtful renovation or envisioning a fresh start, this is a rare opportunity to bring your plans to life.

Living in this delightful apartment will feel like a dream come true. The best of the best is offered living on the spectacular South Cronulla peninsula right across the road from the iconic Shelly Park and beach with ocean pool.

Nestled along the pristine shores of Shelley Beach, this expansive full-floor residence epitomizes the height of luxurious coastal living. SEA showcases a spectacular layout designed for entertaining, effortlessly blending with breathtaking, world-class views. Developed with precision by the acclaimed Sammut Group, this home redefines opulent beachside living and is ready to move in and enjoy.

Set in a highly sought-after beachside suburb, this immaculate single-level duplex offers a lifestyle of low-maintenance ease and modern comfort. With no common living walls and interiors bathed in natural light, it's the perfect coastal retreat just moments from pristine beaches, cafes, shops, transport, and a selection of premier golf courses.

Perched in an elevated position within one of South Cronulla's most tightly held enclaves, this timeless residence captures panoramic views across Gunnamatta Bay and offers the rare privilege of direct beach access on title.

Positioned in a boutique development of just seven, this spacious and tastefully refreshed three-bedroom townhouse enjoys a quiet, sought-after Cronulla location. Showcasing brand-new light fittings, carpet, and a fresh coat of paint throughout, it also offers a sun-drenched rear courtyard ideal for entertaining.

A great opportunity to invest in the heart of Cronulla. with a consistent income, this resort style studio apartment is located in Cronulla's prestigious 'Quest' complex. Surrounded by an array of lifestyle amenities, restaurants, cafes and popular walking tracks and only moments from Cronulla Beach.
Enjoying an enviable location and all on one level, this low maintenance residence presents an exceptional opportunity for those seeking to downsize or a family wishing for a convenient lifestyle.

Now DA-approved, this exceptional 695sqm landholding is ready to unlock its full potential as a premier development opportunity. More than just land-it's a statement of luxury, space, and coastal connection. Set in one of Cronulla's most sought-after streets, this rare offering presents the chance to build an architecturally designed home that blends seamlessly with its stunning bayside surroundings. This is your opportunity to bring a world-class vision to life in a location that defines prestige and exclusivity.

Exuding timeless character and charm, this two-level family residence offers the perfect balance of comfort and functionality. Thoughtfully designed with four bedrooms and multiple living spaces that flow seamlessly to private outdoor entertaining areas, this home presents an exceptional opportunity to add your own modern touches and create a space that truly reflects your style.

Tucked away in a quiet, secluded pocket of Springwood, this beautifully presented three-bedroom duplex offers the perfect balance of lifestyle, location and easy-care living. Positioned on a single level and not part of a large complex, this home delivers privacy and a relaxed lifestyle that will appeal to first home buyers, downsizers and savvy investors alike.

Peacefully located in a popular over 55's complex, this well maintained one bedroom villa is perfect for those looking to down-size. Showcasing a light-filled, open-plan lounge/dining room that leads to the kitchen and onto the rear patio entertaining area, single garage and reverse cycle air conditioning.

Peacefully tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, just 600m from Springwood Village village and approximately 900m to the train station. Enjoy convenient access to everything while still enjoying a private and tranquil setting.

Beautifully renovated throughout and positioned in a peaceful yet highly convenient pocket of Springwood, this impressive family residence delivers the perfect balance of style, comfort and functionality. Set on approximately 710sqm of established grounds, the home has been thoughtfully updated to create a welcoming retreat for growing families, with generous living spaces and seamless indoor/outdoor entertaining.

Positioned on a substantial 1,028m² parcel of land in a sought-after Springwood location, this charming home presents an outstanding opportunity for first-home buyers, downsizers seeking space without the maintenance, and savvy investors looking to secure a quality property in a high-demand area.

Tucked away on a peaceful, tree-lined street that both fronts and backs onto bush, this three-bedroom home offers a rare mix of privacy and convenience just outside Springwood village. Original but neat throughout, it presents a great opportunity for first home buyers looking to get a foot in the door, or investors after a straightforward addition to the portfolio.

This property is phenomenal. 5.5 acres, backing bush, with a gorgeous and spacious light filled cottage home, studio with ensuite, tiny home and inground pool - with the most amazing outlook to the valley that peacefully sits within your backyard.

Offering an affordable entry into the tightly held Springwood market, this split-level unit enjoys a highly convenient location on the corner of Moorecourt Avenue and the Great Western Highway, approximately 500m from Springwood village, cafés, shops, supermarkets and train station. Lovingly cared for and immaculately presented, the property offers comfortable living from day one while appealing to first home buyers, downsizers and investors alike.

Welcome to your dream home nestled in one of Springwood's most sought after streets. This immaculate single level three-bedroom residence offers an ideal retreat for those looking to enter the market or down-size without compromising on style or convenience. Fully renovated throughout and showcasing a huge detached triple 6m x 9m garage with toilet and high ceiling (perfect for a future hoist), this home has much more than the ordinary.

Tucked within the secure Greenhays over-55s enclave in Springwood, accessed off Churchill Street, Springwood, this address places you within an easy stroll directly into Buttenshaw Park and the footpath to Springwood Aquatic & Fitness Centre, with village shops, transport and everyday amenities close at hand.

LOCATION - Tucked away in a peaceful pocket of Springwood, this beautifully updated home offers privacy and quiet while remaining just minutes from Springwood Village, cafés, schools, parks and transport. LOCATION - Perfectly positioned in a highly sought after Springwood pocket, this charming home offers exceptional convenience within approximately 1.2km of Springwood Village shops, 1.6km to the train station, and easy access to Lomatia Park and bus transport. Perfectly positioned in the heart of highly sought-after Springwood Village, this spacious multi-level townhouse provides effortless, walkable living in a prime village location.

Situated on a peaceful parcel in one of Springwood's most sought-after and tranquil neighbourhoods, this home enjoys convenient access to local schools, public transport, and Springwood village, all while offering a quiet and private family environment.

Tucked away in a private setting, this well-presented residence delivers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living. Ideal for first-home buyers, downsizers, or investors, it offers a practical layout with inviting interiors and a relaxed lifestyle to match.

LOCATION - Discover the privilege of living in one of the village's most coveted pockets, where tranquillity meets total convenience. Nestled on a tightly held, tree-lined street, this exceptional home places you just moments from daily essentials - only 80m to the bus, a short stroll to the acclaimed Sassafras Gully bushwalk, and an easy 700m (approx.) walk to vibrant cafés, restaurants, boutique shops and the train.
